items.title: Google Schedules Gemini 3.8 and 3.6 Flash API Price Increases for January 1, 2027
items.summary: Google’s posted schedule doubles paid input, output and context-caching rates for both Flash models. Those rates are unit prices, not an agent deployment’s full bill.

items.title: Top 3 Cash Flow Stocks To Watch In November 2026
items.summary: Tech shares linked to artificial intelligence just went through their worst day since 2025, and that kind of broad sell off often punishes solid cash generators along with the hype. When prices disconnect from the underlying cash flowing through a business, patient investors may find a rare entry point.
